source_facts.base_mechanism: The anchored-percent parse_rate rejects tagged General text. Seven direct lines yield NA; ten statistical children inherit stale numeric zero because a malformed parent does not replace/clear rate_stack. default_base_cols coalesces NA to zero. statutory_base_rate is captured before preference scaling.
